rule_versions.definition: let $sjps := //netex:ServiceJourneyPattern return for $sj in //netex:ServiceJourney return let $sp := $sjps[@id = $sj/netex:ServiceJourneyPatternRef/@ref]/netex:pointsInSequence/netex:StopPointInJourneyPattern, $pts := $sj/netex:passingTimes/netex:TimetabledPassingTime, $seq := for $o in sort(distinct-values($sp/@order ! xs:integer(.))) return $pts[netex:StopPointInJourneyPatternRef/@ref = $sp[xs:integer(@order) = $o]/@id]/(netex:ArrivalTime | netex:DepartureTime), $secs := for $x in $seq return (hours-from-time(xs:time($x)) * 3600 + minutes-from-time(xs:time($x)) * 60 + seconds-from-time(xs:time($x)) + 86400 * number(($x/../netex:ArrivalDayOffset[$x is ../netex:ArrivalTime], $x/../netex:DepartureDayOffset[$x is ../netex:DepartureTime], 0)[1])) return for $i in 2 to count($seq) return $seq[$i][$secs[$i] lt $secs[$i - 1]]
rule_versions.description: NETEX_PASSING_TIMES_INCREASING: arrivi e partenze non decrescenti secondo l’ordine delle fermate e gli offset di giorno. Rappresentazione Config tramite l’XPath 3.1 approvato il 29/10/2026 e mantenuto come oracolo nei test rpsd-core 0.3.0. La fonte Tools usa la funzione equivalente netex_passing_times_increasing; Config non la esegue.
rule_versions.name: Orari progressivi lungo la corsa
